description: Source code for a LitElement-based web component implementing a Todo application, including class definition, event handling, and rendering logic.

classes.name: TodoApp
classes.description: A custom web component extending LitElement that manages a Todo list, handling events, state, and rendering the UI.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the TodoApp component, sets up event listeners.

methods.name: connectedCallback
methods.description: Connects the todo list when the component is added to the DOM.

methods.name: disconnectedCallback
methods.description: Disconnects the todo list when the component is removed from the DOM.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Returns the HTML template for rendering the Todo app UI.

methods.name: #onAddTodo
methods.description: Handles adding a new todo item.
